stream.intro: Intanɛt so kyerɛ slaede koro a projector no kyerɛ, nanso wɔ n'ankasa ahosiesie mu: sɛ wɔnsesa no a, nnwom ne Twerɛ Kronkron ba skrin aseɛ hɔ wɔ kamera no so.
stream.newLinkHint: Link foforɔ ma dada no gyae adwumayɛ, sɛ wɔde maa obi mfomsoɔ so a.
stream.panicHint: Tuntum, Ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Pepa Atwerɛdeɛ yi nsɛm no firi intanɛt so na ɛma kamera no da adi.
stream.sameAsMain: Te sɛ asafo skrin no ara
stream.showAlerts: Kyerɛ nkra wɔ intanɛt so nso
stream.windowInScreens: Sɛ ɛyɛ capture card anaa video switcher a, bue Intanɛt so mpomma wɔ Skrin Ahodoɔ mu.
takeOver.doneTitle: Kɔmputa yi na ɛredi som no anim

takeOver.missing.one: Mfoni, video anaa nnyegyeeɛ 1 a ɛwɔ som no mu nni kɔmputa yi so: ɛbɛyɛ tuntum anaa ɛrenyɛ dede. Nsɛm no bɛda adi sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ.
takeOver.missing.other: Mfoni, video anaa nnyegyeeɛ {count} a ɛwɔ som no mu nni kɔmputa yi so: ɛbɛyɛ tuntum anaa ɛrenyɛ dede. Nsɛm no bɛda adi sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ.

takeOver.onlyOne: Yɛ yei wɔ kɔmputa biako pɛ so. Sɛ kɔmputa titire no san ba a, ɛbɛyɛ adwuma n'ankasa: san fa bɔ ho na mo nyinaa nyɛ adwuma bom.
takeOver.question: Fa som no to kɔmputa yi so? Ɛbɛtoa so afiri slaede a na ɛda skrin so no, ne som nhyehyɛeɛ koro, skrin, mmerɛkanfoɔ ne nnwom koro no ara.
